purpose: Teach: デイトレード/圏内/屈指/約款/朗報/物的/司書/仕掛ける

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員のデイトレード禁止規程を周知しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure everyone knows about the employee day-trading prohibition policy.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient opening. Clear directive tone. Even pacing, professional. No hesitation. The voice of someone running through a checklist with calm authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業圏内のお客様を可視化しました
lines.en: Yes. I've mapped out the customer base in our sales territory.
lines.style: Straightforward confirmation. Measured delivery with a subtle note of accomplished task. No flourish—just competent, steady reporting back.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界屈指のお取引先を大事にしましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we're taking good care of our top-tier business partners.
lines.style: Directive with warmth underneath. Slightly slower than the first line—emphasizing the care, the relationship. The voice leans forward slightly on 「大事に」.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様契約の約款を更新しました
lines.en: Yes. I've updated the customer contract terms.
lines.style: Brief, confirming nod in voice form. Professional, efficient. Slight tonal lift—this task is complete and ready for the next thing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様への朗報を発信しましょう
lines.en: Let's send out some good news to our valued clients.
lines.style: Encouraging direction. Warm but still businesslike. A touch lighter in tone than the prohibition line—this is the positive news moment. Clear and forward-moving.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。物的な裏付け資料を準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare the supporting documentation.
lines.style: Dependable confirmation. Straightforward, no extra emphasis. The tone of someone who will get it done without needing to say so twice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内図書室の司書配置を検討しましょう
lines.en: Let's think about assigning a librarian to staff the company library.
lines.style: Thoughtful direction with a slight shift in topic. Measured pacing. The tone suggests this is worth genuine consideration, not just a line item—a pause before the idea, letting it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品キャンペーンを仕掛けるご相談ですね
lines.en: Yes. So this is about launching a campaign for the new product, then?
lines.style: Engaged confirmation that reads back the intent. Warm, collaborative tone—seeking alignment. A touch of brightness at the end, signaling readiness to move forward together.
